fee_notes: Royalty is structured as a commission split: franchisee receives 70% of Temporary Gross Profits and 70% of Full-Time Placement Sales; franchisor retains 30%. Franchise Support Fee is 1.9% of total gross payroll plus 1.9% of Full-Time Placement Sales. Marketing fund is 0.25% of Sales with franchisor matching contributions. No standard royalty_pct in the traditional sense — the 30% retention is the effective royalty.
raw_excerpt: We pay our Spherion General Staffing franchisees the following commission splits in each Fiscal Year: 70% commission on (and we retain the 30% balance of) the Full-Time Placement Sales; and 70% commission on (and we retain 30% balance of) the Temporary Gross Profits. Franchise Support Fee 1.9% of the total gross payroll plus 1.9% of Full-Time Placement Sales. Spherion Marketing Fund 0.25% of Sales.
